queries.query: Ramagundam Telangana official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official Ramagundam Municipal Corporation portal, Telangana Bhu Bharati land-records portal, and TGRAC ArcGIS REST services. The public parcel-capable layers inspected do not cover the Ramagundam latitude or returned no exact-point feature.

queries.query: రామగుండం తెలంగాణ అధికారిక భూ రికార్డులు మ్యాప్ సర్వే నంబర్
queries.result: Found the official Telangana Bhu Bharati portal with Telugu option and a Telugu listing for Telangana LandGrid. LandGrid states its displayed survey-map data comes from the public NRSC Bhuvan portal; it is not treated as a first-party cadastral registry. No Ramagundam parcel endpoint was evidenced.

freshResearch.sourceScope: Anonymous public GET/POST only; no login, token, CAPTCHA bypass, owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or other unsafe fields requested.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ramagundam Municipal Corporation / Government of Telangana
registryEvidence.qualification: The local official portal evidences municipal property and mutation procedures and links to state services. This is registry/custodian evidence, not evidence that a public parcel-geometry adapter is available for Ramagundam.

parcelSource.provider: Telangana State Remote Sensing Applications Centre (TGRAC), Government of Telangana
parcelSource.coverage: No qualified Ramagundam parcel geometry found. LIS service is EPSG:4326 and lists parcel layers, but its parcel layer extents stop south of Ramagundam (layer 13: 16.0241–16.0739 N; layer 14: 15.9426–17.5302 N). DLS parcel/database extents also stop at 17.9092 N. Hydra cadastral layer uses a projected Lambert CRS and has an extent unrelated to the Ramagundam point.
parcelSource.nativeFieldMapping: TGRAC LIS layer 13 exposes OBJECTID, unique_bsn, parcel_no and globalid among many fields; DLS layer 4 exposes OBJECTID and base-survey identifiers; Hydra layer 0 exposes OBJECTID/geodb_oid/Parcel_num. Unsafe ownership fields were not requested or retained. No feature qualified for retention.

runtimeReadinessReason: No real Ramagundam parcel adapter or bounded parcel sample was independently qualified; research packet only, not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: The exact WUP point is a city reference point, not a guarantee of parcel coverage.
Zero exact-point responses and layer extent misses do not establish citywide cadastral absence.
The Bhu Bharati portal is official and provides land-record procedures, but the public UI/API route was not used for unsafe or owner-linked detail and no anonymous geometry response was evidenced.
